The four ported entrypoints are byte-identical to d54abcbd; the four changed files are not, and never were.

findings_addressed.title: Proof truth
findings_addressed.detail: Rounds 2 and 3 each found this bundle carrying figures from a previous head. Re-synchronising by hand was attempted twice and failed twice. The measured figures are now single-sourced in verification.md, this file's mutation_testing and diff-stat blocks are GENERATED from the battery runner's output and from git, and diff-summary.md quotes no figures at all. The SHA anchor is an ancestor commit used only because a file cannot contain its own SHA; it is not where any figure was measured, and no text in this bundle now claims it is.

p1: Ordering half of finding 1 had no live control (G2 vacuous); L2/L3/M11 all passed green.
p2: Named harm survived at TAB indentation, undisclosed, after the bundle declared the class closed.

p3: Third heading mirror at the empty-acceptance guard.

sign_off.blocking_on: Not ready for merge. The SIXTH independent exact-head review returned CHANGES_REQUIRED and falsified this bundle's own headline structural claim: it asserted that every derived field in all three files was generated by one runner, and FIVE figures were still hand-maintained and stale by exactly one commit -- the scripts/ops diff stat (5294 vs a true 5643), the test delta (+28 vs a true +39), the battery count (24 vs a true 37, printed directly beneath a 37-row table), and the MERGE_SHA anchor prose naming a commit that was no longer the latest implementation commit. The generator now owns every one of them; no figure in this bundle is typed. The same review found FOUR live guards that no test killed, each proved by an executed mutation: curlConfigValue's quote/backslash escaping (only the newline half was covered), fenceClosedBy's minimum-length rule, FENCE_RE's three-space indentation bound, and the readmission non-metadata staged-path guard on the very path this lane exists to harden. All four are now killed by G38/G39/G40/G41. Two of those four fixtures were wrong on the first attempt -- G40's was vacuous on a code path where the bound is dead, and G41's precondition read a worktree lane-start had already torn down -- and both were caught by probing against the mutation BEFORE commit, which is the first time in this lane that this class has been caught pre-commit. Battery at this head is the union of every mutation run across all eight rounds (41), re-executed in full: 41 of 41 detected, no survivors, no anchor misses. Five of six rounds have found a defect the previous round installed or missed, so a clean seventh review is not treated as a formality by this bundle.

review_threads.subject: Reserve all recognized contract headings
review_threads.detail: The reserved set omitted guardrails, all four non-goals spellings, and required evidence/evidence, so a nested non-goal was both left in its acceptance ancestor and extracted as a non-goal. Fixed structurally: extraction and reservation now read one table (CONTRACT_FIELD_SPECS) and every extraction site goes through fieldSpec(). A flat list could not express non-goals' prefix matching in any case.

review_threads.subject: Honor fenced code while parsing headings
review_threads.detail: parseSections now tracks fenced blocks and requires at most three leading spaces. A second half not named in the report was found by assertion: sectionItems flattened a fenced block into one whitespace-collapsed line, putting a shell comment on the same line as the command it warns about. sectionItems is now fence-aware.

mutation_testing.method: Each mutation applied to a sha256-verified baseline, both suites run, baseline restored BY FILE COPY (never git checkout) and re-verified by sha256 before the next mutation. Executed by a scripted runner; this block is its JSON output, not a transcription.
mutation_testing.runner: The UNION of every mutation run across every round of this lane (47), re-executed in full at this head. Executed by a scripted runner over the mutation set published in full in the verification.md appendix (sha256 bb88f50bc2f2d4d7b1431a01a789558e177972902d0c94bd3e63abba2905537a); that appendix is self-contained and re-runs this entire battery on a clean checkout. The seventh review found this field naming three different runners across the bundle; it is now one generated string.
